summary: Text.repeatMax keeps 2^31 - 1 with a reason of its own: the reference raises below every engine's own limit on a string's length (DuckDB past 2^32 - 1 bytes, Polars past u32::MAX, Spark's one JVM byte array), so every route raises at the writers' guard before an engine fails on its own; it also caps the checker's evaluator (#1074).
note: Gives the reason only; no value changes, so no D-number. Replaces the reason that named DataFusion's limit.
